scope: Diagnostic re-evaluation of Settings navigation; not a product feature

harness.isolation: Separate WindowGroup branch; does not construct ContentView or ConnectionController; no VPN start, TLS preflight, scene-resume callback, or launch-time URL open
harness.invocation: UIKit open(_:options:completionHandler:) synchronously from Button actions; no Task and no canOpenURL gate
harness.vpn: Normal Stop path invoked before opening the isolated view; clears pending automatic setup intent

manual-control.destination: User confirmed the LocalFilter-specific Settings page opened

manual-profiles-root.destination: User reported that it does not reach the requested page; previous screenshots showed main Settings for these same URLs

manual-profiles-alternate.destination: User reported that it does not reach the requested page; previous screenshots showed main Settings for these same URLs

runtimeInspection.limit: This inspects one simulator runtime, not the physical iOS 18.6.1 system image. Private flags are implementation details, not a public compatibility contract.

physicalDeviceRoutingEvidence.source: Separate live system-log capture on the same physical phone after the manual-button test
physicalDeviceRoutingEvidence.finding: The URL reaches Settings, whose route provider discards it. An accepted UIApplication.open callback does not establish destination navigation.
physicalDeviceRoutingEvidence.systemProfileDownloadActionSource: The fixed URL in the system's Profile Downloaded follow-up action, observed in the same device log; no follow-up payload or personal metadata is published
physicalDeviceRoutingEvidence.interpretation: The profile path exists inside iOS. Its existence in a system action does not mean a third-party app can invoke it: LocalFilter's direct prefs-scheme profile-list call returned false.
physicalDeviceRoutingEvidence.limit: The log proves rejection by Settings for this App-prefs URL. It does not disclose the complete routing predicate, prove an entitlement-based denial for other schemes, or rule out every alternative navigation mechanism.

infoPlistAudit.finding: LSApplicationQueriesSchemes constrains canOpenURL, not open(_:options:completionHandler:). Missing query declarations do not explain these direct open calls. Registering another app’s incoming scheme with CFBundleURLTypes is not an outbound permission.

privateEvidence: Raw device logs and signing records remain local; only fixed diagnostic strings, URLs, public device model/OS metadata and booleans are published
result: Official app-specific Settings navigation works from a real tap. Profile routes still fail with LocalFilter active on the main thread, without constructing its connection controller. The physical phone's Settings route provider explicitly discards the App-prefs profile-list URL. No working direct profile-list shortcut has been established.
userReport: Button 1 works; the other buttons do not reach the requested page.
